findings.evidence: `spinToSpecialOrthogonal` is literally `(((QuadraticMap.orthogonalGroup Q).subtype.comp (spinToOrthogonal Q)).codRestrict ...)` (TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/CliffordAlgebra/Spin/SpecialOrthogonal.lean:228-233); Mathlib has `MonoidHom.ker_codRestrict (f) (s) (h) : (f.codRestrict s h).ker = f.ker` (Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Subgroup/Ker.lean:294) and `MonoidHom.ker_comp_of_injective (f) (g) (hg) : (g.comp f).ker = f.ker` (same file, line 336), with `Subgroup.subtype_injective` (Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Subgroup/Defs.lean:570).
findings.fix: Delete the private lemma and add, next to the definition in `Spin/SpecialOrthogonal.lean` (where the def body is unfoldable), `theorem ker_spinToSpecialOrthogonal (Q : QuadraticForm R M) : MonoidHom.ker (spinToSpecialOrthogonal Q) = MonoidHom.ker (spinToOrthogonal Q) := by rw [spinToSpecialOrthogonal, MonoidHom.ker_codRestrict, MonoidHom.ker_comp_of_injective _ _ (Subgroup.subtype_injective _)]`, then rewrite with it in `mem_ker_spinToSpecialOrthogonal_iff` (line 370).
findings.issue: `mem_ker_spinToOrthogonal_of_mem_ker_spinToSpecialOrthogonal` proves an inclusion by `Subtype.ext`/`LinearEquiv.ext`/`congrArg` bashing, re-deriving `MonoidHom.ker_codRestrict` and `MonoidHom.ker_comp_of_injective`, which together give the full equality of kernels.

summary: The contraction/exterior machinery and the canonical -1 element are genuinely new; I found no Mathlib or TauCeti declaration they duplicate. One private lemma hand-rolls a kernel comparison that two located Mathlib lemmas already give, and it produces only a one-way inclusion where the equality is available.
